text: The claim is unsupported by the retrieved evidence: POSEIDON compared transendocardial allogeneic vs autologous mesenchymal stem cell injections—not mechanical circulatory support—in chronic ischemic cardiomyopathy (not acute myocardial infarction) and found allogeneic MSCs as safe and effective as autologous, so no evidence indicates allogeneic support is less effective.
